list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.
note: GTA 6 has no online trophies and no difficulty trophies. PowerPyx estimates about 200 hours to the platinum; Push Square reports up to 300 hours or more. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.

trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops automatically once the other 54 are done. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then side characters, robberies, activities and collectibles — and finish with the 100% sweep for A Long Road, which is the longest single job on the list.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and see it through to its end. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally at the start of the game and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do the one thing in the game that can be missed: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house, which counts toward Positive Mental Attitude. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter until that trophy pops.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens after the Breakfast Run mission in this chapter, which also opens the partner trophies, so start calling your partner in from here on.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. This is the chapter where the robbery tools start arriving — Yasmani's jewelry job hands you the Snap Gun for Sneakthief — and where Yago's timed street race appears, so save before that race and do it the moment it shows up.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Near the end of this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is unlocks bank vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal, so take it when it appears.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Play the final story mission to its end. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay, and a save here is your safety net for anything story-related. After the credits, the whole map stays open for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It unlocks character switching between Jason and Lucia, which is what makes the partner trophies possible, so it is a natural step on the way through the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist when it comes up in the story. Like every story-mission trophy it unlocks by playing through the campaign in order, with nothing extra to prepare.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops as you work through the campaign, so just keep playing the story missions in order.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A story-mission trophy that unlocks automatically as the campaign reaches it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It is part of the main campaign, so it comes to you in the normal order of the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Another campaign trophy that unlocks by playing the story missions in order.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which appears after the story. The checklist covers story missions, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries — and the game counts work done before the story ends, so nothing on it is missable. Reported targets on the way include 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles and all 8 bank vaults. This is the longest trophy on the list and the last one before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the total, and the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 instead of stopping. Stunts also feed the Challenges list, so this grind overlaps with One Last Thing.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The fastest way is to sample one of everything the game offers — a race, a round at the shooting range, a fishing challenge, an arcade game, a game of bowling, a meditation spot, a drone race, a stunt and a gym session — and the trophy pops when the last new type is tried. Most types are also needed by other trophies, so this comes cheaply while you work the list.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across two shooting ranges. Each challenge has its own gold score, so replay any challenge you only passed in silver or bronze until it turns gold. Take your time and learn each range's targets before chasing the gold time or score.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race, so you need a first-place finish at every one of them — a win at the same place twice does not cover another. Learn each course's corners before pushing for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Only first-place finishes in distinct races count, so a repeat win on a race you already won adds nothing. Work through the race types across Leonida — street races, off-road and any others on offer — and keep an eye on which ones you have already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing also feeds the Combat Focus meter — each fish landed adds about 10% — so a few rounds of fishing double as preparation for Gunslinger. Take the challenge when it is offered and out-fish Cal.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts, so pick the one you find easiest and play it through to the end. This also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Stranger strands stay available after the credits, so there is no rush — but note that Andy's strand does not count toward the 8 strands of Strangers & Freaks, which only counts certain questlines.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play through Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Like the other side-character finales it stays available after the story ends, so finish it during the post-story cleanup.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play through Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so treat it as its own job in the side-character sweep.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count toward the 8: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish so you know which ones counted, and keep working through stranger encounters until the counter reaches 8.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. It stays available after the credits, so fold it into the post-story side-character sweep.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play through Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so it is a separate job alongside the other side-character finales.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 disappears once Chapter 1 ends, so do it in Chapter 1 — after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony. Bring your partner to outdoor spots, since each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters. Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is Jason-only, and hunt the unique animal it points you to. The questline sends you after animals through target decks, and a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. Work through Bret's targets until the unique animal is down.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida, so explore thoroughly and collect them as you travel — this is a long slow pickup job that fits naturally into the exploration sweep for The Goodtime State. Finish any 3 full sets and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good, so scan traffic as you drive and the two trophies progress together. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 vehicle models discovered, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, listed under Progress and then Challenges. Many challenges complete on their own while you play — stunts, races, robberies and exploration all feed them — so a large share of the 50 will already be done by the time you finish the story. The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80 challenges, so keep going past 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape the heat. The easiest way is during a bank vault robbery, which gives you a 4-star wanted level straight away — escape with your partner and this pops alongside Maximum Withdrawal. Note that the trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — so move fast between shops and do not let the wanted level drop. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive — the same habit that powers You WAiNKer! The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim you trigger by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming. Each fish you land adds about 10% to the Focus meter, so go fishing first to fill it. Then pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle — Adrenaline extends Focus, giving you more time for all five.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count, and the planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military Rhino tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Chapter 3 job, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner — and the 4-star wanted level you get straight away makes this the perfect moment for Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so keep going past 5.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Tail or ambush an armored security van, take its cargo, and get clear of the heat — like Hot Together, this only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The trophy tracks area discovery, so drive, fly and walk into every corner of the map — Vice City, the Keys, the swamps and the countryside — until every area has been visited. This pairs naturally with the card hunt and the WAiNK scanning sweep.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so this trophy pops along the way during the full sweep. Illegal operations are also good hunting ground for Gunslinger, since their guards cluster together.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it with the view. This is a small moment trophy with no grind — just visit the right spot on the beachfront and take the drink in.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Get into a vehicle inside a vehicle showroom and smash your way out through the glass in classic style. Pick a showroom, take a car, and drive it straight out through the front.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper follow-through — play a frame of bowling there and the trophy pops. Bowling also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None, and the Ten Pin trophy is earned with a melee drive-by, not here.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build the partnership up with your partner until it has mass appeal. It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength: buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Keep training together until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed the counter, so it fills up on its own as you play through the robberies, gang operations and general mayhem the list already asks for — no separate grind needed, just keep playing.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try at something you failed the first time. This pops naturally during play — a failed attempt followed by a success, such as retrying a race, a challenge or a robbery after failing it once.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida. This is one of the game's odd-moment trophies — keep your eyes open while exploring the map and the unusual event will find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: drive past on a vehicle and hit them with a melee attack from the moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass near a pedestrian and swing as you go by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and you sell them on to your contacts to clean them. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so keep laundering every marked bill you earn from robberies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so normal spending on weapons, clothes, food and cars while you play counts toward it — and the garage properties for Little Boxes help too.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count. Each car you register for On the Spot also needs a free garage space, so buy the garages before registering cars.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
